summary: Independent review of the single-plex TMT6 cuprizone/calcitriol mouse brain SDRF (6 condition pools x 54 fractions = 324 rows) found no blocking or important issues. Channel-to-sample mapping is stated verbatim in the PRIDE protocol and cross-checked against the deposited PD table headers; all 54 RAW files match PRIDE exactly; both template validations pass. Four minor findings remain.

spec_compliance.evidence: Active templates derived from the file: ms-proteomics v1.1.0 + vertebrates v1.1.0 (mouse sample, DDA TMT technology), consistent with templates.yaml layers (vertebrates=sample layer, ms-proteomics=technology). 39 columns, all rows 39 cells, no empty cells; all required columns of base/sample-metadata/vertebrates/ms-proteomics present (developmental stage present as 'not available', which the vertebrates template allows). source name+assay name unique (324 unique assay names). Label values TMT126..TMT131 valid for TMT6plex. Modification, ms1 scan range, collision energy and template syntax accepted by validators; tools structure reports column order and template declaration consistent.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE PXD002347 (title 'Multiple sclerosis cuprizone mouse model and vitamin D supplementation') sampleProcessingProtocol states C57Bl/6, right frontal brain incl. some corpus callosum, pooling per condition (n=6/6/4/6/6/6), labels 'Ctr7 (TMT126), Ctr8 (TMT 127), Ctr10 (TMT 128), VitD7 (TMT129), VitD8 (TMT 130), VitD10 (TMT131)', mixed-mode HPLC into 60 fractions with 1-3 pooled and 4-7 excluded (54), Orbitrap Elite DDA, HCD NCE 40%, FTMS 300-2000 m/z, fragments in Orbitrap at R=7500. dataProcessingProtocol: trypsin, 10 ppm, 0.05 Da, Carbamidomethyl C/TMT6plex K/TMT6plex N-term fixed, Oxidation M variable. Nystad 2014 APMIS abstract (PMID 24862867, cited by PRIDE for the animal work): 'female C57Bl/6 mice', 0.2% cuprizone 7 weeks, calcitriol or placebo (vehicle). Deposited PD table headers 'A6: 129 D7/126 Pl7', '130 D8/127 Pl8', '131 D10/128 Pl10' independently confirm the channel map. Sampling times 7/8/10 week from the project description.

file_mapping.evidence: Fresh PRIDE file list (55 files, projectAccessions={PXD002347}): 54 RAW + 1 SEARCH xlsx. The set of 54 SDRF comment[data file] values equals the PRIDE RAW set exactly (no missing, extra or non-raw). Each file appears in exactly 6 rows (one per TMT channel); each (file,label) pair is unique; fraction identifier 1 = TMT6_frac_1to3.raw and 2..54 = TMT6_frac_8..60.raw in order, one id per file.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: 6 source names (one pool per condition) x 54 fractions = 324 rows; single TMT6plex mix, technical replicate 1 throughout. Each label maps to exactly one source with consistent characteristics and factor values: TMT126 Ctr7 placebo 7 week, TMT127 Ctr8 placebo 8 week, TMT128 Ctr10 placebo 10 week, TMT129 VitD7 calcitriol 7 week, TMT130 VitD8 calcitriol 8 week, TMT131 VitD10 calcitriol 10 week. Factors (treatment x sampling time) form a full 2x3 design matching the VitD/Ctr ratios per timepoint in the processing protocol. pooled sample/biological replicate 'pooled' is consistent with README guidance for pooled samples; no hidden confounder beyond the inherent one-pool-per-condition design.

omission_safety.evidence: Every value traced to PRIDE protocol, Nystad 2014 abstract or deposited table. Unsupported-specificity search: no age/developmental stage invented ('not available'), no pool members invented (plain 'pooled'), no reduction/alkylation reagents invented (columns omitted), fraction identifiers declared ordinal in the manifest limitations, MaxQuant listing in PRIDE correctly ignored. Remaining omissions (corpus callosum component, cuprizone exposure, ITMS/Orbitrap wording conflict) are minor and recorded below.

findings.message: Organism part records only 'right frontal lobe' (UBERON:0002810, defined as frontal cortex of the right hemisphere), but the source states the tissue is 'right frontal including some corpus callosum'; the corpus callosum is the principal cuprizone demyelination site.
findings.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: 'individual mouse brain samples (right frontal including some corpus callosum)'. OLS UBERON:0002810 definition: 'A frontal cortex that is part of a right cerebral hemisphere.' Correction criterion: optionally add a second characteristics[organism part] column 'corpus callosum' (UBERON:0002336), which the column's multiple cardinality allows.

findings.message: Disease uses the broader 'demyelinating disease of central nervous system' rather than the modelled human disease; SAMPLE-GUIDELINES suggests the human disease name for animal models. The broader term is accurate for toxic cuprizone demyelination, so no change is required.
findings.evidence: SAMPLE-GUIDELINES.adoc: 'For animal disease models, use the human disease name to facilitate cross-species comparisons.' PRIDE diseases: DOID:2377 Multiple sclerosis; keywords 'Multiple sclerosis'. Correction criterion: either keep with rationale or use 'multiple sclerosis' (MONDO:0005301).

findings.message: The protocol is internally inconsistent: it says '10 MS/MS acquisitions (ITMS)' but later 'Fragments were detected in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 7500'. The SDRF value 'orbitrap' follows the more specific statement (a resolution value only applies to Orbitrap detection), but the manifest does not record the conflict.
findings.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol text. Correction criterion: note the ITMS/Orbitrap wording conflict in the evidence manifest limitations; value can stay.

findings.message: The shared 0.2% cuprizone dietary exposure for all animals is not captured as a treatment; it is only implied via the disease value. Treatment column distinguishes only calcitriol vs placebo, which is the experimental factor and is correct.
findings.evidence: Nystad 2014 abstract: 'demyelinated with dietary 0.2% cuprizone for 7 weeks'; PRIDE protocol 'cuprizone administration'. Correction criterion: optional; could be added as an extra characteristics[treatment] column 'cuprizone' if desired.
